intent: Eight individually authored character tasks distinguish the person praised, actual action, comparison and context-specific word sense.
picturePurpose: Original loose-board/assembled-stand comparison identifies a visible use of wood, not intelligence or the provenance of spare materials. A speaker-and-people selection distinguishes of you from for us.

workshop.title: 看清谁做了什么，再选评价词
workshop.instruction: 圈人物、辨木料用途，再根据行为和语境选词。

items.label: kind：谁的举动值得感谢
items.prompt: 谁的做法得到称赞？留意of you和for us。
items.material: It was kind of you to wait for us.
items.after: of you to wait for us.
items.reason: It is kind of somebody to do用于评价某人的做法。这里夸你愿意等我们；of you指被夸的人，for us指等待的对象。这不说明对方每次都这样做。
items.hint: 先分清of you和for us指向谁。

wordDecision.prompt: 谁的做法得到称赞？留意of you和for us。

recordSelection.title: 圈出被夸kind的一方
recordSelection.prompt: 哪一方因等待而受到称赞？

rows.label: 你／你们
rows.text: The person or people being addressed waited for the group.

recordSelection.hint: of you指被夸的人，for us不是动作执行者。
recordSelection.wrong: 只圈你／你们：you等us，别把两方对调。
recordSelection.quote: It was kind of you to wait for us.

options.text: The group being waited for is praised for doing the waiting.
options.reason: us是被等待的人，不是句中被夸等待的人。

options.text: The person or people being addressed are praised for waiting.
options.reason: of you把kind指向你；for us说等谁。

options.text: Only the speaker is praised for waiting.
options.reason: 把of you换成说话者本人了。

items.label: friendly：忙碌时依然友善
items.material: The staff were friendly even when the cafe was busy.
items.after: even when the cafe was busy.
items.reason: friendly是形容词，放在were后说明工作人员的态度；不是因以-ly结尾就当副词。even when说明即使咖啡馆很忙，工作人员依然友善。不能换主语或补成只有空闲时才友善。
items.hint: 盯住staff和even when，不靠词尾猜词性。

recordSelection.title: 人和忙碌情境都保留
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 忙碌时依然友善
rows.text: The staff were friendly even during a busy period.

rows.label: 只有空闲时友善
rows.text: The staff were friendly only when the cafe was empty.

rows.label: 换成顾客
rows.text: Only the customers are described as friendly.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选忙碌时依然友善；别补only或换成顾客。

options.text: They were friendly only when the cafe was empty.
options.reason: busy被换成empty，还加了only。

options.text: Only the customers are described as friendly.
options.reason: 原句主语是staff，不是customers。

options.text: The staff remained friendly while the cafe was busy.
options.reason: even when保留忙碌时依然友善。

items.label: polite：礼貌的请求更有效
items.prompt: 礼貌请求和喊叫，原句怎样比较？
items.material: A polite request is more effective than shouting.
items.after: request is more effective than shouting.
items.reason: polite是形容词，修饰request；politely是副词。more effective than表示比……更有效，比较方向不能反过来。礼貌请求不等于对方必须答应，也没有给出效果提高了多少。
items.hint: request前选形容词；比较方向看than两侧。

wordDecision.prompt: 礼貌请求和喊叫，原句怎样比较？

options.text: A polite request is more effective than shouting.
options.reason: more effective than比较礼貌请求与喊叫的效果。

options.text: Shouting is said to be more effective than a polite request.
options.reason: 把比较方向反了。

options.text: Every polite request is guaranteed to get exactly what the speaker wants.
options.reason: 比较效果不保证每次都如愿。

items.label: rude：先听完，再判断打断
items.prompt: 哪种行为不礼貌？别漏掉without listening。
items.material: It is rude to interrupt without listening.
items.reason: It is rude to do评价一种做法。这里是没听就打断别人；without listening限制了打断的方式。不是说所有说话或认真听别人讲完都不礼貌。
items.hint: 把to interrupt和without listening一起保留。

wordDecision.prompt: 哪种行为不礼貌？别漏掉without listening。

recordSelection.title: 被评价的是哪种打断
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 听到最后
rows.text: Listening to the speaker until the end is rude.

rows.label: 所有说话都粗鲁
rows.text: Every act of speaking is rude.

recordSelection.hint: 不听就打断，不是所有说话。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选不听就打断；不能换成倾听或扩大成所有说话。

options.text: Listening until the speaker finishes is called rude.
options.reason: 把without listening换成认真听完，动作变了。

options.text: Interrupting without listening is described as rude.
options.reason: to interrupt without listening是受评价的行为。

options.text: All speaking is described as rude.
options.reason: 原句限制了行为，不是所有说话都粗鲁。

items.label: honest：诚实的回答帮了忙
items.prompt: 诚实的回答起了什么作用？
items.material: An honest answer helped us solve the problem.
items.after: answer helped us solve the problem.
items.reason: honest的h不发音，首音是元音，所以用an honest answer。honest是形容词，修饰answer。helped us solve说明起了帮助；它不证明所有问题都能只靠一个回答解决。
items.hint: an看发音；helped不等于唯一万能办法。

wordDecision.prompt: 诚实的回答起了什么作用？

recordSelection.title: 回答诚实，并且起了帮助
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 诚实回答起了帮助
rows.text: An honest answer helped the group solve the problem.

rows.label: 一招解决所有问题
rows.text: It was the only possible solution to every problem.

rows.label: 不诚实回答帮了忙
rows.text: A dishonest answer was the stated help.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选诚实回答起了帮助；不能编唯一办法或换成不诚实。

options.text: The answer is stated to be the only possible way to solve every problem.
options.reason: 没有only，也没有every problem。

options.text: A dishonest answer is named as the help.
options.reason: honest不是dishonest。

options.text: An honest answer helped the group solve the problem.
options.reason: helped us solve说明诚实回答对解决问题起了帮助。

items.label: brave：求助，而不是躲起来
items.prompt: 孩子实际选择了求助，还是躲起来？
items.material: The brave child asked for help instead of hiding.
items.after: child asked for help instead of hiding.
items.reason: brave修饰child。asked for help是已经做的事，instead of hiding指出没有选择的做法；of后面用hiding。勇敢可以是害怕时仍愿意求助，不能推出完全没有恐惧。
items.hint: 保留实际求助；别把勇敢等同于不害怕。

wordDecision.prompt: 孩子实际选择了求助，还是躲起来？

recordSelection.title: 求助是行动，无惧不是结论
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 求助，而非躲藏
rows.text: The child asked for help rather than hiding.

rows.label: 躲藏，而非求助
rows.text: The child hid instead of asking for help.

rows.label: 完全无惧
rows.text: The child is proved to have felt no fear at all.

recordSelection.hint: instead of不能倒过来；恐惧程度没写。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选求助，而非躲藏；不能反转行动或补完全无惧。

options.text: The child asked for help rather than hiding.
options.reason: instead of hiding说明选择求助，没有选择躲起来。

options.text: The child hid instead of asking for help.
options.reason: 把asked for help和hiding对调了。

options.text: The sentence proves the child felt no fear at all.
options.reason: brave不等于完全没有害怕，原句没报告恐惧程度。

items.label: clever：剩余木料的新用法
items.prompt: 点出用木料搭成的小架子。clever在句中评价什么？
items.material: That is a clever way to use the spare wood.
items.after: way to use the spare wood.
items.reason: clever可形容人，也可评价办法。这里修饰way，to use the spare wood说明这个办法做什么。图片只区分散放木板与组装支架，不测量聪明程度，也不证明木料来源；spare由原句说明。
items.hint: 先认木料的用途，再看clever修饰way。

wordDecision.prompt: 点出用木料搭成的小架子。clever在句中评价什么？

art.alt: 左侧散放的木板；右侧组装成的双层小木架。

evidence.caption: A是散放木板，还不是组装好的架子。原句没有说明木料的数量。
B是组装好的小木架。clever评价使用木料的办法；图片不测智力，spare由文字说明。

options.text: These are loose boards that have not been assembled.
options.reason: 这张图只摆着木板，不是搭好的支架。

options.text: The wood has been assembled into a small stand.
options.reason: 支架是木料的一种新用法；clever评价办法，不能靠图片测智商。

items.label: smart：这次说穿着，不是智力
items.prompt: 看见jacket，这里的smart是哪种意思？
items.material: The jacket makes him look smart.
items.reason: smart有聪明的意思，也可在英式英语中形容穿着整洁得体。这里jacket和look指向外表，选穿着义。make somebody look加形容词，不加looks，也不能推出穿衣会提高智力。
items.hint: jacket提示穿着义，不见smart就只译聪明。

wordDecision.prompt: 看见jacket，这里的smart是哪种意思？

recordSelection.title: 按夹克和外表选择词义
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 穿着整洁得体
rows.text: The jacket makes him look neat and well dressed.

rows.label: 智力提高
rows.text: The jacket is proved to increase his intelligence.

rows.label: 外表脏乱
rows.text: The jacket makes him look dirty and untidy.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选穿着整洁得体；衣着语境不支持智力提高。

options.text: The jacket is proved to increase his intelligence.
options.reason: 穿夹克不等于智力提高，语境是外表。

options.text: The jacket makes him look dirty and untidy.
options.reason: 和穿着整洁得体的意思相反。

options.text: The jacket makes his appearance look neat and well dressed.
options.reason: 衣服让他看起来整洁得体，这里不是说智力。

transfer.stem: Which notes match the people, actions and meaning of smart?
transfer.passage:
WORKSHOP VISIT
Our group reached the cafe late, but Mei waited for us. ‘It was kind of you to wait,’ I told her. Inside, the staff were friendly even though the cafe was busy.
At the workshop, I shouted across the room for a ruler. Mei tried a polite request instead, and the teacher heard her clearly. Later I interrupted someone without listening and was reminded to wait.
An honest answer helped us find the problem with our model. One child asked for help instead of hiding it under the table. Then we found a clever way to use the spare wood: we made a small stand.
For the group photograph, Bo put on his jacket. ‘You look smart,’ said Mei, straightening his collar. We put the stand beside our model.

options.text: Mei’s waiting was kind; the child asked for help; smart describes Bo’s neat appearance.
The cafe staff waited for the group; the child asked for help; smart describes Bo’s neat appearance.
Mei’s waiting was kind; the child hid instead of asking for help; smart describes Bo’s neat appearance.
Mei’s waiting was kind; the child asked for help; the jacket increased Bo’s intelligence.

answer.display: Mei’s waiting was kind; the child asked for help; smart describes Bo’s neat appearance.

explanation.strategy: 先找谁等了大家，再核对求助和躲藏，最后用夹克和衣领判断smart的词义。

steps.text: Mei等了大家；孩子选择求助，而不是把模型藏起来。
steps.reason: Mei waited和asked for help instead of hiding定位人物与实际动作。

steps.text: 夹克、合影和整理衣领都指向穿着整洁得体。
steps.reason: 外表语境支持smart的穿着义，不支持提高智力。

distractors.reason: 等大家的人是Mei，不是咖啡馆工作人员。
把实际求助和没有选择的躲藏倒过来了。
smart在穿衣语境表示整洁得体，夹克没有提高智力。

explanation.pitfall: 把人或动作对调，或只背一个中文义而忽略语境。

visual.title: 人物、行动、语境
visual.caption: 评价词要与具体人物、行为和语境相连。

explanation.transfer: 另一个故事出现smart phone时，还能直接译成穿着整洁吗？先看它修饰什么。
